title: Six Seven in stack
body:
This mod changes Minecraft so that item stacks now hold 67 items instead of the default stack sizes.

Due to questionable decision-making and a lack of better ideas, Minecraft gameplay becomes noticeably worse and more chaotic, since stacking behavior is no longer balanced in the usual way. This is an intentional design choice based on the popular “67” meme, which is the core idea behind the mod.
